name: Cannes-Mandelieu Airport

hours.v: air traffic control open from 08:00 local; closing 20:00 in winter, 21:00 in spring and autumn, 22:00 from early May to late August (FBO opens 06:30)
hours.quote: FBO and ATC closing hours (local time)

max_aircraft.v: general aviation only, no scheduled airline flights; jets over 35 t and turboprops over 22 t MTOW are not allowed
max_aircraft.quote: AD reserved for general aviation operations or tourism; ACFT equipped with turbojet engines, whose MTOW exceeds 35 t.

noise.v: noisier aircraft (margin under 13 EPNdB, ICAO chapter 3) are banned; APU use limited to 20 minutes before and 10 minutes after flight
noise.quote: Ban on noisier aircraft (<13 EPNdB ICAO chapter 3)

slots.v: listed by the French slot coordinator (COHOR) as Level 3; business and general aviation slots are requested through the handling agent
slots.quote: General and business aviation operators ask their handling agent Skyvallet to request slots

handling.v: handling agent named by the coordinator: Skyvallet

runway.v: main paved runway 17/35, 1,540 m by 45 m; also paved 04/22 (760 m by 18 m, mainly helicopters, daytime only) and grass 17/35 (550 m by 50 m, unusable after rain)

curfew.v: aerodrome closed at night outside air traffic service hours; ATS 07:00 to 19:00, 20:00 or 21:00 UTC in winter (one hour earlier in UTC in summer), set by NOTAM, which is 08:00 to 20:00, 21:00 or 22:00 local all year; the window below is the widest closure, so check the NOTAM for flights after 20:00
curfew.quote: Outside ATS SKED : - aerodrome is closed during night time; 0700-1900 ou / or 0700-2000 ou / or 0700-2100 selon / according to NOTAM.

missing: ppr (the current AIP pages state no PPR; the only prior request is for compulsory handling)
customs (current AIP gives only a customs phone number, no hours)
